facts.fact: COBAC authorised Commercial Bank Cameroun on 11 June 2025 to run a Wave mobile payment service on condition of mandatory interconnection to the GIMAC system, monthly reporting and safeguarding of funds at BEAC, per Agence Ecofin.

systems.owner: Commercial Bank Cameroun with Wave Transfer S.A.
